diagrams.title: Expense Tracker Data Model
diagrams.description: Entity Relationship diagram representing the Expense entity and its attributes based on the data model specification.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
    USER ||--o{ ENT-EXPENSE : "owns"
    ENT-EXPENSE {
        int id PK
        real amount
        string category
        string description
        string date
        string created_at
    }

diagrams.title: Data Validation Workflow
diagrams.description: Logic flow for validating an expense record against the defined functional requirements and constraints.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    START[Start Expense Creation] --> VAL_AMT{"Is amount > 0?"}
    VAL_AMT -- "No" --> ERR_AMT["Trigger ValidationError: RULE-AMT-POS"]
    VAL_AMT -- "Yes" --> VAL_DATE{"Is date YYYY-MM-DD?"}
    
    VAL_DATE -- "No" --> ERR_DATE["Trigger ValidationError: RULE-DATE-ISO"]
    VAL_DATE -- "Yes" --> VAL_CAT{"Is category in Enum?"}
    
    VAL_CAT -- "No" --> ERR_CAT["Trigger ValidationError: RULE-CAT-ENUM"]
    VAL_CAT -- "Yes" --> VAL_DESC{"Is description string?"}
    
    VAL_DESC -- "No" --> ERR_DESC["Trigger ValidationError: CONS-DESC-STR"]
    VAL_DESC -- "Yes" --> SAVE[Save ENT-EXPENSE to DB]
    
    ERR_AMT --> END[End Process]
    ERR_DATE --> END
    ERR_CAT --> END
    ERR_DESC --> END
    SAVE --> END

diagrams.title: Requirements Traceability Matrix
diagrams.description: Mapping of validation rules and constraints to the core Expense entity to ensure full coverage.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart LR
    subgraph "Validation Rules"
        RULE-AMT-POS["RULE-AMT-POS: Positive Amount"]
        RULE-DATE-ISO["RULE-DATE-ISO: ISO 8601 Date"]
        RULE-CAT-ENUM["RULE-CAT-ENUM: Category Enum"]
        CONS-DESC-STR["CONS-DESC-STR: Description String"]
    end

    subgraph "Core Entities"
        ENT-EXPENSE["ENT-EXPENSE: Expense Record"]
    end

    subgraph "Assumptions"
        ASSUMP-USER-LOCAL["ASSUMP-USER-LOCAL: Single User Context"]
    end

    RULE-AMT-POS -->|implements| ENT-EXPENSE
    RULE-DATE-ISO -->|implements| ENT-EXPENSE
    RULE-CAT-ENUM -->|implements| ENT-EXPENSE
    CONS-DESC-STR -->|implements| ENT-EXPENSE
    ASSUMP-USER-LOCAL -->|relates_to| ENT-EXPENSE
